name: ContextMenu
label: Context menu
description: Right-click menu at the pointer with groups, sub-menus, and shortcut hints.

props.name: items
props.description: Menu entries — DropdownMenu's model (items, groups, separators). A context menu draws an item's label, icon, shortcut, selected and destructive states; it does not draw `description` or `checked`, and `closeOnSelect` is not read.

props.name: keyLabels
props.description: Replaces any legend an item's `keys` is written with, such as `{ ctrl: 'Strg' }` for a German keyboard.

props.name: children
props.description: The right-clickable area the menu is attached to

Shortcut.description: A shortcut in the grammar above, such as `mod+k`, `shift+?` or `g i`.

ShortcutKeyLabels.description: The legends a shortcut is drawn with, by modifier or key name. Merged over the platform's defaults.
